messages:
Sam Lee: Hey team — customer (HealthCo) sent back the CAIQ and specifically asked us to show the shared-responsibility lines for encryption, key management, logging, and backups. They want this for the POC SOW by EOD tomorrow. Can we clarify what Redwood answers vs what the customer owns?

Lina Torres: Quick summary: Redwood = platform controls (server-side encryption, network isolation, access logging, secure images). Customer = data classification, consent for PHI, key ownership when using customer-managed KMS in Private mode, and application-level redaction.

Sam Lee: Can you give one concrete snippet I can paste into the CAIQ rows?

Lina Torres: Yup. Draft snippet below that maps to the typical CAIQ control categories (ENCR/KEYMGMT/LOGGING/BACKUP). Feel free to paste and I'll formalize.

Lina Torres: ```
- ENCR-01 (Encryption at rest): Redwood-managed AES-256 encryption by default. For Private deployments, customer may bring their KMS; if so key rotation and access control are customer responsibilities.
- KEY-02 (KMS ownership): Hosted: Redwood manages keys. Private: optional customer-managed KMS (customer responsible for key policy and rotation).
- LOG-03 (Access & audit logging): Redwood captures platform audit logs and provides export hooks (S3/CloudWatch). Customer is responsible for retaining and analyzing logs for their app-level events.
- BACK-04 (Backups): Redwood provides automated host-level snapshots for recovery. Customer responsible for application-level backups of transactional data and any long-term retention policies.
```

Ben Chu: I would add one sentence re: Dedicated vs Hosted — Dedicated still uses Redwood-managed keys unless customer opts for Private with KMS. Small nuance but customers ask.

Ravi Patel: Also call out telemetry: we redact request bodies in storing platform traces by default (PII redaction flag enabled). If customer needs full request bodies for debugging they must opt in and manage retention.

Marta Gomez: Product note: For POC we can enable a short-term log export to their bucket (read-only IAM role) so they can validate logging. I'll attach the steps in the CAIQ response doc.

Sam Lee: Great. Can someone turn Lina's snippet into the CAIQ answer format and mark the control owner columns (Redwood / Customer)? I need to send to HealthCo security.

Lina Torres: On it. I'll produce a one-pager with the owner mapping and a short summary of mitigations by 5pm PT. Will include the exact CAIQ rows referenced.

Ben Chu: I'll prep the commercial note about Private KMS and pricing delta for bringing your own key and add it to the POC SOW.

Ravi Patel: FYI — for Private deployments we require a network runbook and KMS connection test before data onboarding. I'll add that to the checklist.

security-bot: Reminder: attach the updated CAIQ file to the ticket and tag @legal for sign-off on the wording.

Sam Lee: Awesome, thanks. Lina, Ben, Ravi — cc'ing @legal when you post the final. :thumbsup:

Lina Torres: Thanks — will post final doc in #sales by 17:00 and link the CAIQ export. :lock:
